records.title: Post office Regulations
details: a to d: Necessary action to amend the provisions of the Post office Regulations is being taken by the Department of Posts in this regard.

records.title: Civil Aviation Requirement provisions
details: b to d: The CAR regulation on handling of unruly passengers is presently under public consultation. The provisions of the CAR will be finalized after due consideration of the comments received.

records.title: Dependency of Students on Coaching Institutes.
details: a to d: The government has constituted a committee on 17.06.2025 to discuss issues relating to coaching and work towards reducing the dependency of students on coaching.

records.title: Implementation of forest rights ACT
details: c: Yes, the Ministry of Tribal Affairs has received the said representation

records.title: Incidents of Tail Section of Aircraft Scrapping the Runway
details:
(a) & (b): Since 2023 to 2025 (till date), there have been 07 incidents
of tail strike/scrap of significant safety concerns wherein Directorate General of Civil Aviation/ Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (DGCA/AAIB) has instituted the investigation. This also includes the incident at Chennai airport.

records.title: Rational of Draft UGC Regulations, 2025.
details:
b to e: These draft regulations have been placed in the public domain for
feedback, suggestions and wide consultations and the last date to receive feedback from stakeholders has been extended to 28.02.2025. Various suggestions, comments and feedback have been received from different stakeholders. The feedback so received will be analysed by an Expert Committee for incorporating suitable suggestions in the regulations.

records.title: Rationalisastion of GST Rates
details:
Part (a); The GST Council in its 45th meeting held on 17th September, 2021, has constituted a
Group of Ministers to look into rate rationalisation. No report of the Group of Ministers is
pending for consideration of the Council.

records.title: Inviting bids for supply of ethanol
details:
Under this scheme, commercial Second Generation (2G) bio-ethanol projects has been set up by Indian Oil Corporation Ltd. (IOCL) at Panipat (Haryana) and are being set up by Hindustan Petroleum Corporation
Ltd. (HPCL) at Bhatinda (Punjab), Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd. (BPCL) at Bargarh (Odisha), Numaligarh Refinery Ltd. at Numaligarh (Assam) and Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Ltd. at Davangere (Karnataka).
